verdict.rationale: Publishing an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary is a fair question for a state filing agency, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any machine-readable specification. The Gateway and tax pages describe only human-facing portals, guides and forms, and the ohiosos.gov and Business Central hosts returned 403 at robots.txt, so nothing further was fetched.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
